entities.name: Wacław Żyliński
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wacław Żyliński was a Roman Catholic archbishop of the Archdiocese of Mohilev from 1856 to his death in 1863. He previously served as bishop of the Diocese of Vilnius from 1848 to 1856.
